name: Gift Card Manager for WooCommerce
author: Fulfillment.Global

sections.description:
This plugin allows site administrators to generate Gift Cards on WooCommerce sites.

The settings page for this plugin is available under the following menu on the WordPress admin dashboard: Marketing -> Gift Cards.

Gift Cards can be generated on the settings page.

A [gcm-claim] shortcode is made available by this plugin, which you can insert anywhere on your site, to allow customers to enter and claim Gift Codes which you have generated.

When a user claims a Gift Card, the Gift Card amount is immediately added to the user’s wallet funds, and an email is sent to the site administrator to inform them of the claim.

A daily report email can be configured, listing all Gift Card claims that occurred during the day.

Currently, the TeraWallet (Wallet for WooCommerce) plugin is supported, for adding funds to a customer’s wallet, when they claim a Gift Card.

Third party service description

This plugin does not make use of any third party services. No data is collected or submitted by this plugin.

This plugin’s source code may be verified for confirmation.

Usage

Install and activate the plugin.

Configure the plugin on the settings page (under WordPress Admin -> Marketing -> Gift Cards).

To disable Gift Card Manager for WooCommerce on your site, simply deactivate or uninstall the plugin.

Note that all of the plugin’s tables in the database will be removed when the plugin is uninstalled. Please create a backup of your database should you need to keep the plugin’s data, before uninstalling the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, this plugin is free to use. The source code is available for you to examine what the plugin does and how it works.
